Forged crawler identity presented by the nine active hosts of 94.154.46.0/24 on AS202412, the Finding 2 fleet. The sessions figure is this exact string's own volume across those nine addresses this period. This is a correct Googlebot string, so the string alone is not the indicator and blocking on it would also block the real crawler: the indicator is the string arriving from a source address outside Google's published crawler ranges. Verify every inbound Googlebot claim by source address, then escalate any mismatch that also requests an environment file, a .git path or an AWS configuration path. The durable control is the GoogleBot Pretender tag, which GreyNoise recommends blocking.
